metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in the United Kingdom increase in February 11-25, 2019 compared to the same period average from 2000-2012?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Need LST (Land Surface Temperature) data for UK - Compare: February 11-25, 2019 vs. average of Feb 11-25 for years 2000-2012 - MODIS provides LST data: `MODIS/006/MOD11A1` (daily, 1km) - Location: UK bounding box approximately (-8, 50, 2, 59) 2. **Masking Strategy**: - LST data may have quality flags. Need to filter for valid pixels. - No cloud masking needed for LST directly, but QC bands indicate data quality. - Filter for good quality LST values only. 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Valid LST range: ~250-330 K (roughly -23 to +57°C) - If mean LST is None or outside valid range → C3 - If pixel count is 0 after QC filtering → C2 - If no images found → C1 - Compare 2019 value vs 2000-2012 average: - If 2019 > average → A (Yes, increase) - If 2019 ≤ average → B (No increase) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define UK geometry and date ranges const uk = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-8, 50, 2, 59]); // Target period: Feb 11-25, 2019 const startDate2019 = '2019-02-11'; const endDate2019 = '2019-02-25'; // Historical period: Feb 11-25, 2000-2012 (average) const historicalYears = [2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012]; // 2. Collect 2019 data const lst2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterBounds(uk) .filterDate(startDate2019, '2019-02-26') .select('LST_Day_1km'); const count2019 = lst2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Feb 11-25: ${count2019} images`); if (count2019 === 0) { console.log('C1: No images found for 2019'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Collect historical data (2000-2012, same period) let historicalCollection = ee.ImageCollection([]); for (let year of historicalYears) { const startDate = `${year}-02-11`; const endDate = `${year}-02-26`; const yearCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterBounds(uk) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('LST_Day_1km'); historicalCollection = historicalCollection.merge(yearCollection); } const countHistorical = historicalCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2000-2012 Feb 11-25: ${countHistorical} images`); if (countHistorical === 0) { console.log('C1: No historical images found'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Calculate mean LST for 2019 (convert from K*0.02 to K) const mean2019Img = lst2019.mean().multiply(0.02); const stats2019 = mean2019Img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: uk, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val2019 = stats2019['LST_Day_1km']; const validPixels2019 = lst2019.first().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: uk, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo()['LST_Day_1km']; console.log(`2019 LST: ${val2019 !== null ? (val2019 - 273.15).toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C, Pixels: ${validPixels2019}`); if (validPixels2019 === 0 || val2019 === null) { console.log('C2: No valid pixels in 2019'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean LST for historical period (2000-2012) const meanHistoricalImg = historicalCollection.mean().multiply(0.02); const statsHistorical = meanHistoricalImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: uk, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const valHistorical = statsHistorical['LST_Day_1km']; const validPixelsHistorical = historicalCollection.first().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: uk, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo()['LST_Day_1km']; console.log(`2000-2012 LST: ${valHistorical !== null ? (valHistorical - 273.15).toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C, Pixels: ${validPixelsHistorical}`); if (validPixelsHistorical === 0 || valHistorical === null) { console.log('C2: No valid pixels in historical data'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 6. Validate LST ranges (should be 250-330 K) if (val2019 < 250 || val2019 > 330 || valHistorical < 250 || valHistorical > 330) { console.log(`C3: Invalid LST values (2019: ${val2019}K, Hist: ${valHistorical}K)`); console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Compare const diff = val2019 - valHistorical; console.log(`Difference: ${diff.toFixed(2)}K (${(diff * 1.8).toFixed(2)}°C increase)`); if (diff > 0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
